technical-summary: HL01: recorded lspci -vv and IOMMU findings (identical PCIe settings on XTX 0/XTX 1/R9700 and their root ports, iommu=pt identity groups; no configuration cause for XTX 0's host-read contention) plus in-engine evidence from the rad0031 timeline (XTX 1 reduce 1301 vs 889 us, ~400 us barrier wait). HL02: TP3 all-reduce arm and pass criterion. VTP36: timeline table, x4 data-floor analysis (R9700 sends S, receives (1+w)S), one-shot vs hierarchical, decode R9700 idle, new experiments (uneven XTX shares, 5,5,6). New VTP38: host-reduced prefill all-reduce (CPU sums partials and pushes to VRAM so no card pulls host memory), gated on HL02 and RAD50 R9700 path.
user-summary-candidate: Recorded that the PCIe contention on the TP3 host has no settings cause, and planned a CPU-reduced all-reduce to work around it and the R9700's x4 link.
